recommendation.rationale: All candidates were measured locally; 1500 is the portable baseline and 4096 is an injectable local candidate when the end-to-end path is proven. 8500 is not selected because loopback throughput cannot establish external path MTU or fragmentation safety. The buffer range spans the measured stalled and nominal settings; constrained 4096-byte queues are fault-injection only.
